title: 需求澄清与模型细化
scope: 保留显式有限解释澄清及原文/typed候选检查；新增有限候选审阅和用户动作记录，无语言传输、自动抽取或回答驱动自动修订。
implemented_scope: Explicit finite interpretation lists with raw-byte-pinned sources, injected preview/observation, minimax boolean questions, immutable answer history and successor-task-bound proposals; standard library and protocols only; no exhaustive interpretation search, automatic gap classification, semantic fidelity proof, model writes or LLM judge; raw UTF-8 source requests and unconfirmed domain definition candidates with attributed concepts/attributes/relations/rules/issues, strict structural inspection and prompt preparation, no language transport/extraction or rule execution Adds source/request-bound typed-domain-candidate/0.1 inspection and finite-language prompt preparation; no live language transport, answer-driven revision, or independent semantic acceptance. Instance rule execution belongs to the explicit apps adapter, not this package. Adds immutable finite candidate review sessions, independent review revisions and user-action provenance; answer/decline/confirmation/edit proposals remain separate from semantic acceptance and automatic candidate revision. Persistence belongs to the explicit app. Adds saved ProjectModel references, deliberate whole-proposal adoption with immutable prior candidate/review history and cross-version isolation; offline revision-context/0.1 separates source text from recorded user answers/declines. No automatic revision model call or semantic acceptance.
